primary_sources.supported_claim: Disaster reporting progresses through initial, progress, terminal, and final reports; cumulative SitReps require reporting periods, prevailing conditions, actions, effects, issues, recommendations, geographic disaggregation, and attributable sources.

The precise template configuration, approval chain, retention schedule, privacy classification, and acceptable performance thresholds remain organization-dependent.

proposed_revision_content.recommended_title: A Role-Based Disaster Incident Reporting and Record Management System for Participating DRRM Organizations
title_alternatives: A Multi-Organization Disaster Incident Reporting, Verification, and Record Management Platform
A Traceable Disaster Information Workflow and Record Management System for Local DRRM Organizations
A Responsive Web-Based Disaster Incident and Situation Information Management System
proposed_revision_content.general_objective: To design, develop, and evaluate a responsive, role-based web system that enables participating DRRM organizations to capture, verify, consolidate, retrieve, and monitor traceable disaster incident records while preserving organization-scoped authority, access, and record history.
specific_objectives: Develop organization and user management that separates each participating organization's users, jurisdictions, roles, configurations, and records and logs security-relevant changes.

Develop structured incident reporting that records source, place, occurrence and submission times, hazard, impacts, needs, actions, attachments, uncertainty, and submission state, with validation and possible-duplicate checks.

Develop human-led verification that supports triage, source and version comparison, clarification, duplicate and conflict flags, reasoned decisions, and preservation of submitted and corrected versions.

Develop controlled SitRep drafting that consolidates only eligible organization and jurisdiction records, identifies the reporting period and unresolved discrepancies, and traces sampled values to source records and verification decisions.
Develop a searchable record catalog that preserves incident and SitRep versions, relationships, classifications, audit events, and organization-controlled export.
Develop role-scoped dashboards showing provisional and verified values, status, coverage, and processing time with disclosed filters, update time, missing data, and drill-down to permitted records.

Evaluate the modules with scripted functional, integration, organization-isolation, accessibility, recovery, and role-based user tests, reporting each measure with its numerator, denominator, task conditions, failures, and sample characteristics.
proposed_revision_content.transition: These objectives address the observed fragmentation, repeated clarification, manual consolidation, limited access, and version-preservation needs without treating document generation as the system's primary contribution or claiming that software independently verifies facts or improves emergency outcomes.

local_context_and_workflow.location: Zamboanga City, with a configurable multi-organization design for participating provincial, city, municipal, barangay, or other authorized DRRM organizations.
stages: Consolidate eligible versions into a draft SitRep
Retrieve, export, correct, or supersede while preserving history
local_context_and_workflow.channels_and_handoffs: Current inputs may arrive through calls, text, messaging, photographs, radio, field personnel, and office records. The bounded implementation provides a connected web workflow and system of record; existing telephone, radio, paper, and other contingency channels remain necessary during outages.
local_context_and_workflow.fallback_practice: Record an interrupted submission as failed or requiring reconciliation, prevent silent duplicate creation, and allow authorized staff to encode information received through approved contingency channels once connectivity returns.

problem_root_cause_consequence.observed_practice: Information arrives from multiple divisions and channels and often requires follow-up.
problem_root_cause_consequence.root_cause: No shared structured intake and status trail across contributing actors.
problem_root_cause_consequence.operational_consequence: Repeated clarification, re-entry, uncertain provenance, and delayed consolidation.
problem_root_cause_consequence.bounded_system_response: Structured submissions with stable identifiers, source and time metadata, acknowledgement states, validation, and duplicate flags.

problem_root_cause_consequence.observed_practice: Staff call barangays or dispatch personnel to confirm reports while also holding other operational roles.
problem_root_cause_consequence.root_cause: Incomplete evidence, inconsistent source quality, and limited dedicated verification personnel.
problem_root_cause_consequence.operational_consequence: High workload and slower resolution of uncertain or conflicting records.
problem_root_cause_consequence.bounded_system_response: A human-led review queue with comparison, clarification, conflict flags, reasoned decisions, and version history; no automated truth determination.

problem_root_cause_consequence.observed_practice: A consolidator edits source material into different detailed and summarized outputs.
problem_root_cause_consequence.root_cause: Source information and report categories are not consistently structured or linked.
problem_root_cause_consequence.operational_consequence: Repetitive transcription and difficulty tracing consolidated values.
problem_root_cause_consequence.bounded_system_response: Assemble a reviewable draft from eligible versions and retain source links; approval and external submission remain human and organizational acts.

problem_root_cause_consequence.observed_practice: Reports originate in several functions, access is limited, and updates should not erase earlier submissions.
problem_root_cause_consequence.root_cause: Distributed custody without a consistent version, authorization, and audit model.
problem_root_cause_consequence.operational_consequence: Loss of historical context, ambiguous responsibility, or unauthorized disclosure.
problem_root_cause_consequence.bounded_system_response: Organization-scoped access, immutable material history, searchable records, retention metadata, audit events, and controlled export.

title_and_terminology.title_rationale: The recommended title foregrounds the enduring functions—incident reporting and record management—while leaving SitRep drafting as one module and avoiding an unsupported national or official-report claim.
title_and_terminology.incident_record: A time-stamped, source-attributed digital record of an observation, impact, need, action, or update associated with an incident; it is not necessarily verified or official.
title_and_terminology.SitRep: A cumulative situation report for a defined operational or reporting period that summarizes the prevailing situation, actions, effects, issues, and recommendations from eligible sources; system generation produces a draft until authorized approval.
title_and_terminology.reporting: The capture and submission of observations or updates by an identified source.
title_and_terminology.validation: Automated or procedural checks for required fields, format, range, consistency, and possible duplication; validation does not establish factual truth.
title_and_terminology.verification: A documented human assessment of a report against sources or evidence by personnel authorized by the participating organization.
title_and_terminology.coordination: The exchange and alignment of information and responsibilities among authorized actors; the platform supports but does not exercise command authority.
title_and_terminology.monitoring: Role-scoped viewing of recorded status, coverage, timing, and values; it is not forecasting or automatic decision-making.
title_and_terminology.record_management: Controlled creation, classification, access, versioning, retrieval, retention, export, preservation, and authorized disposition of records and their metadata.

objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Tenant, jurisdiction, role, and support-access controls
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Two-organization access-control test log and audit trail
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: All scripted permitted actions succeed and all scripted cross-organization or unauthorized actions are blocked and logged.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Correct identity, role, organization, and jurisdiction configuration
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: Testing does not prove resistance to every attack or production compliance.

objective_acceptance_trace.problem: Incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, or interrupted submissions
objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Forms, explicit unknown states, validation, stable IDs, and submission acknowledgement
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Seeded valid, incomplete, conflicting, duplicate, and interrupted-report test set
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: Report applicable-field completeness, valid-value rate, duplicate-warning result, and permitted state-transition success are reported separately with numerators and denominators.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Agreed field definitions and realistic test records
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: Form completeness does not establish factual accuracy.

objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Review queue, source/version comparison, clarification, conflict flags, and reasoned decisions
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Workflow log for seeded conflicting, corrected, late, and rejected records
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: Every scripted decision records actor, time, reason, evidence reference, and preserved prior version; verification turnaround is measured.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Authorized reviewers and evidence available for the scenario
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: The system cannot determine truth or replace professional judgment.

objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Eligibility filtering, aggregation, source links, versioning, and approval state
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Expected-versus-generated SitRep dataset and source-traceability matrix
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: Report exact aggregation accuracy and the proportion of sampled consolidated values traceable to an eligible source and verification decision.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Configured categories, reporting period, jurisdiction, and eligibility rules
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: A generated draft is not automatically an official NDRRMC issuance or external submission.

objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Search, compare, supersede, audit, retention metadata, and export
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Retrieval, version-preservation, backup-restore, and customer-export test results
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: Scripted records and versions are retrieved accurately; restoration result and export completeness are reported with missing items identified.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Backup, retention, classification, and export configuration
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: Retention and disposition remain subject to the responsible public office's approved policy and law.

objective_acceptance_trace.problem: Status and coverage are difficult to interpret
objective_acceptance_trace.module_or_function: Summaries, disclosed filters and periods, missing-data labels, accessible alternatives, and drill-down
objective_acceptance_trace.verification_artifact: Expected-versus-displayed values and WCAG 2.2 test results
objective_acceptance_trace.measurable_success_indicator: Displayed values match the scripted dataset; each chart has a textual or tabular equivalent; accessibility results list applicable criteria and failures.
objective_acceptance_trace.dependency: Correct source data, filters, permissions, and browser support
objective_acceptance_trace.limitation: Dashboard values reflect recorded data and do not prove absence of unreported impacts or support forecasting.

scope_boundaries_and_nonclaims.included: A responsive web application for participating DRRM organizations, covering configured users and jurisdictions, floods, typhoons, and fires, structured incident records, human verification, draft SitRep consolidation, catalog and version management, export, audit history, and role-scoped dashboards.
excluded: Automatic official publication or external submission
dependencies: Organization-approved roles, workflow, templates, retention, and privacy rules
safe_claims: The prototype structures and traces recorded incident information.
It can assemble a reviewable local SitRep draft from eligible records.
It can enforce tested role and organization boundaries under declared test conditions.
It can report measured task, data-quality, workflow, recovery, accessibility, and isolation results.
claims_to_avoid: Produces an official national SitRep by generation alone
Improves emergency decisions or public-safety outcomes
Is procurement-ready, commercially viable, nationwide-ready, or production-ready
